---
title: "7.1_stage_meta_and_priority_surface"
output: html_document
params:
  curve: "q025"
  taxa: "mammals_birds"
  sdm: "ppm_rangebag"
  cells_to_remove_per_iteration: 1000
  pruning_iterations_per_stage: 100
  ana_subdir: "ana"
  stage_meta_name: "stage_meta.csv"
  overwrite: true
  validate_bundle_metadata: true
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Build stage metadata for a completed script-6 priority run and validate the
# canonical proportional-removal priority surface, rankmap.tif.
if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
}
```

```{r run_stage_meta_surface}
source("R/stage7_stage_meta_surface.R", local = knitr::knit_global(), print.eval = TRUE)
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
cat("\nStage 7.1 summary\n")
cat("=================\n")
cat("Curve: ", params$curve, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Taxa: ", params$taxa, "\n", sep = "")
cat("SDM: ", params$sdm, "\n", sep = "")
if (exists("stage_meta_csv")) cat("Stage metadata: ", stage_meta_csv, "\n", sep = "")
if (exists("priority_surface_tif")) cat("Priority surface: ", priority_surface_tif, "\n", sep = "")
```
